title: Identification and Validation of a Novel WNK2 Inhibitor: A New Genetically Informed Target for Osteoarthritis Drug Development.
snippet: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a disease characterized by loss of joint space, degeneration of cartilage at articular surfaces, remodeling of bone and other joint tissues, low-grade inflammation, and pain.
